attchmntText: OM INFRA LIMITED has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Om Infra Limited announced standalone and consolidated un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board approved these results on 14th November 2026. The Limited Review Report by statutory auditors A. Khandelwal Badaya & Co. is qualified. The auditors could not verify inventory quantity and valuation due to dispersed locations. Additionally, results for two joint operations were unavailable for the period, relying instead on audited balance sheet figures from 31st March 2026. Standalone segment revenue for the half year was Rs. 42070.84 lacs. Profit before tax for the half year was Rs. 832.38 lacs. Total assets stood at Rs. 110206.58 lacs as of 30th September 2026. The company disclosed that constraints impacted project execution pace.

attchmntText: OM INFRA LIMITED has informed the Exchange about General Updates
